tools.description: List native Yab actions with their strict argument schemas, targetKind, undo support and permission requirements. Query matches the id or title. Only listed actions can be performed; settings marked user_only cannot be changed by an agent.

tools.name: native_apply
tools.description: Perform a native Yab action explicitly requested by the user: settings, spaces, tabs, page fonts or connecting Gmail. Read native_context and native_actions first. Give the exact target id/kind and schema arguments, expectedVersion from context where available, and a unique requestId for this effect. Reuse the same requestId on retries, never for another payload. needs_user means a confirmation in Yab; running means OAuth is still pending. Follow native_operation until verified; never claim completion beforehand. This does not grant Mac access or permission to change the agent's own rules.

Read this task's native operation by operationId, or wait for a change up to seconds (0 to 10). cancel stops an unfinished operation and invalidates its OAuth attempt. A verified connection can still be syncing; read native_context for current mail status. Unknown outcomes after a restart must be reconciled by reading actual state before another attempt.

tools.description: Undo a native change of this task by its changeId (or the last undoable change). Later manual edits and changes after a Yab restart are preserved: a conflict means read current state instead of forcing Undo. Account disconnection and deletion are not undoable.

tools.name: run
tools.description:
Run JavaScript that drives tabs with the same tools, several steps in one call: loops over pages, forms filled in a go, a list scrolled until a row shows. Each method is the tool of the same name and goes through the same checks (Send, Pay and the like still wait for the user). Synchronous (await is fine and does nothing). Print with console.log; the value you return is printed too. A failed step throws with the tool's message.
  const t = open(url)            // or tab(id), tabs()
  t.snapshot({interactive})      // text; t.refs(/Invite/) → [{ref, line}], t.find('Save') → ref or null
  t.click(ref) t.click({x, y}) t.type(ref, text, {submit}) t.type(text) t.choose(ref, value)
  t.press(keys) t.hover(ref) t.drag(ref, toRef) t.drag(ref, {dx, dy}) t.scroll(ref|null, dy)
  t.dialog(accept, text) t.text() t.wait(forText) t.navigate(url) t.fetch(url) t.show() t.close()
  sleep(ms), keep (an object that lasts between runs)
Each action returns what changed on the page, as the tool does. At most 200 steps a run.
